### McGraw Hill Announces Agentic AI Education Plugin for Microsoft Copilot


October 29, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/964897494/files/doc_news/McGraw-Hill-Announces-Agentic-AI-Education-Plugin-for-Microsoft-Copilot-2026.pdf)


New AI interface lets educators responsibly integrate McGraw Hill’s trusted content with Microsoft Copilot to create a secure, more pedagogically grounded education experience


Key Highlights:


- **Connecting to trusted content and curriculum through Microsoft Copilot:** McGraw Hill’s higher education and school district customers who have a Microsoft 365 Copilot license will be able to access McGraw Hill’s trusted course materials through Copilot to create personalized study aids, lesson plans, learning tools and other resources grounded in McGraw Hill’s pedagogical approach.
- **McGraw Hill among the first major education companies with a Microsoft 365 Copilot plugin:** McGraw Hill will make its proprietary K-12, higher education and professional learning content available through Copilot using Model Context Protocol (MCP), which securely connects to external AI agents and content.
- **Advancing agentic AI in education:** McGraw Hill’s agentic AI strategy will enable its customers to build expert AI agents that can be used by educators and learners, expanding the learning markets the company serves.


COLUMBUS, Ohio--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


McGraw Hill, Inc. (NYSE: MH), a leading global provider of education solutions for preK-12, higher education and professional learning, today announced that it will enable McGraw Hill’s higher education and school district customers who have a Microsoft 365 Copilot license to access McGraw Hill’s trusted content through Copilot to support teaching and learning in new and innovative ways.


McGraw Hill’s higher education and school district customers who have a Microsoft 365 Copilot license will be able to access McGraw Hill’s trusted course materials through Copilot to create personalized study aids, lesson plans, learning tools and other resources grounded in McGraw Hill’s pedagogical approach.


McGraw Hill is among the first major education companies to make its proprietary K-12, higher education and professional learning content available to Copilot users through Model Context Protocol (MCP), a standard that allows AI tools like Copilot to securely connect with external content and systems.


Educators and students affiliated with McGraw Hill’s higher education and school district customers who have enterprise use of Copilot will have the ability to access McGraw Hill content via the Microsoft 365 Copilot plugin to summarize, translate and adapt the course materials they license to generate additional resources, study aids and lesson plans connected to their courses.


The launch of McGraw Hill’s Copilot plugin marks another step in how the company is shaping agentic AI for education by making its extensive course library, created by world-class experts and grounded in proven pedagogy, accessible through trusted AI agents. As AI evolves from general-purpose models toward more specialized experiences, McGraw Hill’s collaboration with Microsoft gives educators a secure way to access McGraw Hill educational content to support personalized teaching and learning needs in real time, while protecting the value of McGraw Hill’s content, authors and learning solutions.


“AI represents a new growth opportunity for McGraw Hill, enabling us to bring our trusted content to more people, in more ways, across a growing range of platforms,” said Dave Cortese, Chief Digital Information Officer at McGraw Hill. “Our collaboration with Microsoft demonstrates how we can expand into new channels while maintaining control over how our content is used and valued. These relationships complement our core business by enabling us to meet educators and students where they already are, making McGraw Hill content seamlessly available within the digital ecosystem they use every day.”


“The next chapter of AI in education will be shaped by experiences that are grounded in credible content and connected to the way teaching and learning actually happen,” said Deirdre Quarnstrom, Vice President, Microsoft Education Experiences. “McGraw Hill is an important partner not only because of the quality and credibility of its content, but because of its scale, reach and the trust it has built with educators over generations. Bringing those strengths to Microsoft Copilot can help educators create more relevant learning experiences while giving institutions a secure, governed way to adopt AI responsibly.”


The work with Microsoft builds on McGraw Hill’s broader strategy to help educators and students use AI responsibly and effectively, extending the company’s work beyond its growing portfolio of AI tools embedded in McGraw Hill’s digital learning products, including AI Reader, Sharpen, Learning Studio, Writing Assistant, Teacher Assistant and other AI-powered solutions designed to meet specific teaching and learning needs. Learn more about McGraw Hill’s approach to AI here:[https://www.mheducation.com/about-us/trust-center/our-ai-approach.html](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mheducation.com%2Fabout-us%2Ftrust-center%2Four-ai-approach.html&esheet=54630715&newsitemid=20261029005737&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mheducation.com%2Fabout-us%2Ftrust-center%2Four-ai-approach.html&index=1&md5=95c6bbc5c0604481759f4fa7f49407d3)


McGraw Hill’s Copilot plugin is one part of the company’s work with Microsoft to use AI to improve the learning experience for the millions of learners it serves around the world. McGraw Hill also recently selected Copilot as its enterprise AI productivity solution to help its employees build AI fluency, accelerate learning and work more effectively across the organization.


McGraw Hill will begin a limited beta of its Copilot plugin in early 2027. For more information on participating in the beta test, please visit:[https://www.mheducation.com/about-us/campaigns/ai-connector-beta.html](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mheducation.com%2Fabout-us%2Fcampaigns%2Fai-connector-beta.html&esheet=54630715&newsitemid=20261029005737&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mheducation.com%2Fabout-us%2Fcampaigns%2Fai-connector-beta.html&index=2&md5=7db6cc8a682d56ceb73bdcb069844a6e)


**McGraw Hill**


McGraw Hill (NYSE: MH) is a leading global provider of education solutions for preK-12, higher education and professional learning, supporting the evolving needs of millions of educators and students around the world. We provide trusted, high-quality content and personalized learning experiences that use data, technology and learning science to help students progress towards their goals. Through our commitment to fostering a culture of innovation and belonging, we are dedicated to improving outcomes and access to education for all. We have over 30 offices across North America, Asia, Australia, Europe, the Middle East and South America, and make our learning solutions available in more than 80 languages.
